about: Wall-clock upper bounds in Rust tests still tighter than scripts/check-timing-asserts.mjs allows, when it landed (S23, 2026-10-17). Keyed by path and trimmed line text. Only shrinks (check-timing-asserts.test.mjs pins the count): fix one (paused clock, or a cause assert and a wide bound, or a `// timing: <reason>` comment) and delete its entry; never add one for a new bound.
